# Vendored

`preact-htm.js`: htm 3.1.1's `preact/standalone.module.js` (Preact with its hooks, and htm), from
https://unpkg.com/htm@3.1.1/preact/standalone.module.js, unchanged. Preact is MIT-licensed; htm is Apache-2.0.
Kept here so the console needs no build step and loads nothing from elsewhere (its CSP allows only this bridge).
